## Highlights since 0.15.1

- **Math preview above the formula.** The live preview of the formula you are editing now appears just above it, so it no longer covers the lines below.
- **Annotations land on the right words.** A note's mark on the PDF now covers the same words as its source, its pin sits in the margin, the empty list is a centred drawing, and the toolbar shows the note count beside its icon.
- **Nothing covers your work.** The Proofread card scrolls into view, after a successful build the Build panel docks under the PDF instead of floating over it, Overleaf collaborators' names show briefly instead of always, and actions that need a selection say so.

## Notable fixes

- "Save and revise now" revises only the note it saves.
- Opening a sheet no longer rewrites the file or adds an edit to History.
- ⇧-click Build cleans the project before building again.
- Jumping between the PDF and the source keeps working after the project folder moves.
- Borders and focus rings are no longer cut off at the edge of a scrolling list, the titlebar starts at the edge when the window lights are hidden, and the Build button is centred.
- Tabs, setup, the command palette, Check references, History, Annotations and dialogs are tidier, and lists use quieter punctuation that follows your language.
- The browser demo shows Overleaf, Add papers, History, Versions and Rewrite honestly, and its narrow dark page is fixed.
- The app starts with less code to load.
